javascript.description: Custom JS injected as an inline <script> in the published page and run by the browser during HTML parse. Full access to page globals. To fire a custom-named analytics event, call the provider global directly — e.g. window.gtag('event', '<name>', {...}) for GA4, window.fbq(...) for FB Pixel, window.dataLayer.push(...) for GTM. IMPORTANT: fire from a deferred trigger (e.g. element.addEventListener(...)), NOT at parse time — window.gtag is installed by the deferred site bundle that runs after parsing, so an immediate call no-ops. The global also only exists once its provider is connected (GA4 => site.apps.googleAnalytics); guard with window.gtag?.(...).
